title: He Made $15 Billion Betting Against America #shorts
description:
In 2007, a hedge fund manager nobody knew bet against the US housing market while Wall Street laughed. Then the bubble burst.
Follow for more stories of fortunes made overnight.
hook_text:
HE MADE $15 BILLION
BETTING AGAINST AMERICA
first_comment: Genius or lucky? Paulson saw what the banks 'missed', or ignored. What do you think? 👇

lines.text: In two thousand and seven, a hedge fund manager nobody knew made fifteen billion dollars in one year.
And he had never traded housing before.
In two thousand and six, he noticed something strange.
Americans were buying houses they could not afford.
Banks packed those risky loans into bonds and called them safe.
Paulson decided to bet against them.
The bet cost him almost nothing. If he was wrong, he would lose little.
The bonds collapsed, and his bets exploded.
His funds made fifteen billion dollars. He took home nearly four billion himself.
Follow for more stories of fortunes made overnight.
